summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend verification of the 5 new features (holidays with auto-bump, skip_sundays, admin profile update, change-password, backup download, WhatsApp/PDF on LoanDetail). 13/13 new pytest cases pass. 14/14 previous regression tests still pass. Playwright E2E validated Settings page (all 12 data-testids present), holiday add/save/persist/remove flow, NewLoan skip-sundays visibility toggle by modality, LoanDetail PDF download (jsPDF blob generated, file estado-C0001.pdf downloaded, zero console errors), and WhatsApp message containing 'Fecha de inicio' + 'Fecha estimada de cancelación' lines. Backup download from Settings triggers file with correct attachment. GET /api/admin/export-all correctly returns 404.

minor.issue: Carry-over from iteration_2: list_loans was rewritten with proper $in batching in this iteration (server.py L376-390), so the N+1 concern from previous report is now RESOLVED.

The holiday bump logic (L281-301) only bumps installments whose current due_date matches a newly added holiday. If bumping produces a new date that itself falls on another already-existing holiday, it's handled (loop uses new_holidays set). Edge case is OK. Suggestion: also propagate the bump to subsequent installments so the whole cadence shifts, otherwise later installments may still land on holidays that were added earlier without re-scan. Not blocking.

issues: Native browser date picker (input type=date) used instead of a shadcn calendar component; acceptable but inconsistent with other date fields; keep for MVP.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L807-814: CORS still uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combination. Cookie-based auth will silently fail cross-origin; frontend actually uses Bearer token so it works, but CORS config is technically invalid.

server.py L825: seed_admin uses ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars with a fallback to admin@example.com/admin123. Since the request states admin is nutricrispy@gmail.com, ensure backend/.env has ADMIN_EMAIL=nutricrispy@gmail.com and ADMIN_PASSWORD=Prestamos2026! — verified working via login.

server.py update_settings bump logic (L281-301): only handles installments whose current due_date == newly added holiday. Does not re-schedule following installments; and it does not bump if a holiday date was in DB but a Sunday now (skip_sundays toggle case).

server.py backup (L776-799): user_id filter is correct; installments filtered by loan_ids (also correct). Good separation. Consider excluding password fields defensively (currently none included). OK.
LoanDetail.jsx sharePdf uses navigator.canShare — in Chromium headless it correctly falls back to save+toast. Verified.
Files still <500 lines each; no urgent refactor needed. Loan/Settings pages remain readable.
